blocks.summary: Motivation, Data-Evolving Paradigm, alpha-Curriculum Reward, and benchmark gains.
High cost and static nature of interaction data, limitations of static expert datasets, GenEnv simulation framework, and 3 core contributions.
Two-player curriculum game view, Agent Policy and Environment Policy co-evolution.
Data-Evolving Paradigm vs static loss minimization; feedback loop targeting breaking points.
Structured action space vs natural language, exact execution, soft similarity, Equation (1).
Empirical success rate p_hat, bell-shaped reward peaked at alpha=0.5, Equations (2)-(3), difficulty filter.

blocks.section: 2.3 Data Structures and How New Training Data Is Produced
blocks.summary: Environment generated task batch T_t, agent trace e in E_t, D_train and D_env growing pools, data-evolving closed loop.
Player 1 agent update via GRPO, Player 2 environment update via RWR, and Algorithm 1 co-evolution loop.

blocks.section: 3.1 Intermediate Difficulty Maximizes Agent Learning Signal
blocks.summary: Bandit formulation, score function norm, Assumption 1, Proposition 1, gradient signal proportional to p(1-p), Remark 1.

blocks.section: 3.2 Ranking Consistency of the alpha-Curriculum Reward
blocks.summary: Theorem 1 Hoeffding-bound exponential consistency of R_env, implications for ZPD calibration.
Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct backbone, 5 benchmarks (API-Bank, Bamboogle, ALFWorld, BFCL, TravelPlanner), baselines (GenEnv-Random, GenEnv-Static, Gemini-Offline), GRPO and RWR training setup.

blocks.section: 4.2 RQ1: Does GenEnv Improve Downstream Task Performance?
blocks.summary: Main benchmark results analysis, +40.3% on ALFWorld, closing the gap to 14B-72B models, stable training dynamics.

blocks.section: 4.3 RQ2: Does GenEnv Learn to Tackle Harder Tasks Over Time?
blocks.summary: Emergent curriculum analysis, response length growing from 137 to 204 tokens (+49%), multi-step reasoning progression.

blocks.section: 4.4 RQ3: Is GenEnv More Data-Efficient Than Gemini-Based Augmentation?
blocks.summary: Validation score 0.458 vs Gemini-Offline 3.3x 0.438 with 3.3x less data, +12.3% over RandomEnv.

blocks.section: 4.5 RQ4: Does the Environment Reward Produce Well-Calibrated Difficulty?
blocks.summary: Empirical convergence of success rate from 0.138 into [0.4, 0.6] band centered at alpha=0.5, empirical validation of Theorem 1.
